## Welcome to
Florida, MA

Florida is a town in Berkshire County, Massachusetts, United States. Part of the Pittsfield Metropolitan Statistical Area, it is home to the eastern portal of the Hoosac Tunnel and sits at an elevation of 2,172 feet — the highest point on the Mohawk Trail.

Incorporated in 1805, Florida is governed by an open town meeting form of government, led by a Board of Selectmen and served by a dedicated team of departments and volunteers.

Town Hall, the Highway Department, and the Senior/Community Center will be closed in observance of Columbus Day.

4th Annual Haunted Hayride — October 24

Florida Volunteer Fire Department's 4th Annual Haunted Hayride, October 24, opens at 6:30 p.m. Rides start at Chilson's Pond, 80 Tilda Hill Road, Florida, MA. $10 per person, children 5 and under free. All proceeds benefit the Florida Volunteer Fire Dept.
